newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in early afternoon trading Wednesday as investors cashed in profits from Tuesday's 75-point surge, which was fueled by the Federal Reserve's decision to hold the line on interest rates.
At 12:50 p.m. EDT, the Dow was down 51.51 points at 7,251.95, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
